review_evidence: README identifies KittyCats as an undergraduate category-theory formalization built from first principles without Mathlib, covering categories, functors, natural transformations, limits, monoidal/closed categories, adjunctions, monads and Yoneda.
16 of 17 current primary Lean files own about 82 common declarations; Monad.lean, Yoneda.lean, Instances.lean, Thm.lean and Morphism.lean are representative theorem/structure modules.
KittyCats.lean is the sole declaration-light primary file and is the project import root, so it remains useful navigation metadata.
summary: Retain the complete first-principles KittyCats category-theory formalization and root import module.
